capabilities: Display the 100 most common vault words in a graph view
Exclude specific words from the scan
Set the scope of the vault scanning
Copy or export the full word list as .txt or .json
disambiguation: Not about most-used notes or commands; it analyzes the most frequently written words in your notes.
extras: The README notes the full word list is only available after using the graph feature at least once.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see which words you use most often across all notes or to extract a complete vault word list.
summary: Word-frequency analyzer that graphs the 100 most common words across your vault and can export the full word list.
